The Aggregation-breakage PBM models how activated sludge flocs change in size during flocculation. It predicts the floc size distribution over time, representing aggregation between flocs and breakage of larger flocs. The model is a one-dimensional population balance that is discretized into size classes and solved using the moving pivot method. It was calibrated using online laser-diffraction measurements from flocculation experiments at two mixing intensities, with several distribution measures tried as fitting targets.
